description: She wears a cream full-length court gown with a low square neckline, fitted paneled bodice and elbow-length sleeves. Purple-and-gold woven geometric bands outline the neckline, shoulder straps, cuffs, waist, long central skirt borders and hem. Small round decorative fittings sit near the upper bodice and waist. A deep purple wrap with matching gold-toned edging rests around the forearms and hangs down both sides of the skirt. The lower front opening reveals a purple underlayer and gold-toned closed shoes. Small earrings, a round pendant necklace and a decorated bracelet are visible. Opaque fabrics look fine and textured; precise fibers are uncertain. Upper chest and forearms are exposed while bust, abdomen and pelvis are covered.
